description: This file implements the PreferStylusOverTouchBlocker class, which manages input events to prioritize stylus input over touch input, canceling touch events when a stylus is active, and handling device state changes.

classes.name: PreferStylusOverTouchBlocker
classes.description: A class that manages input events to prefer stylus input over touch input, canceling touch events when a stylus is active.

methods.name: processMotion
methods.description: Processes motion input events, cancels touch events if a stylus is active, and manages internal state accordingly.

methods.name: notifyInputDevicesChanged
methods.description: Updates internal device state based on the current list of input devices.

methods.name: notifyDeviceReset
methods.description: Resets internal state for a specific device when it is reset.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current internal state for debugging.
